race.comment: MELODEE ROSE (4) ran on too late fresh up at Leeton 12 days ago, and will get a significant jockey upgrade with Blaike McDougall taking over from an apprentice. She will have plenty of time to wind up down home straight here, and she is expected to be very competitive. REDS CITY (6) probably found it a bit sharp for her over 1050m at Leeton last start when caught wide and back after making a good beginning. She is worth another chance over 1200m, and will also have a senior hoop in the irons this time. If she can find the top without using up too much energy, then she could take plenty of catching, so stick with her. STAR EMPIRE (2) improved sharply second up to take them all the way at Canberra just over 6 weeks ago. Don't underestimate him in this. JAZZ ALL KNIGHT (1) is nicely placed here after a 2kg claim, and she can run her usual honest race. Each way value.
